description: 4 exemplars (1 de) + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Exemplars create or edit a persona under src/agent-src/personas/. Near-misses share the persona vocabulary and route elsewhere: user research personas for a product (customer-research), improving an existing persona from usage evidence (persona-improvement), and a voice and tone guide for product copy (voice-and-tone-design). Counterexamples guard 'persona' and 'voice' in unrelated senses.

queries.q: add a reviewer persona for accessibility with its own unique questions
create a new specialist persona for database migrations in src/agent-src/personas/
edit the security persona so its output expectations name the severity vocabulary
leg eine neue Persona für Performance-Reviews an, mit Fokus und Leitfragen
build three user personas for our onboarding redesign from the interview notes
the qa persona keeps missing edge cases in reviews — improve it from these transcripts
queries.note: evidence-driven refinement of an existing persona → persona-improvement

queries.q: define the voice and tone for our product's error messages
record a voice memo transcription feature for the mobile app
switch the AWS CLI profile to the staging account
queries.note: 'profile' as a CLI config, not a persona
